pdfimages -list samples/13_nebenkostenabrechnung_2025.pdf; pdfinfo samples/13_nebenkostenabrechnung_2025.pdf | head -20; grep -il "nebenkost\|betriebskost\|MV-2025" -r . 2>/dev/null; for f in samples/*.pdf; do pdftotext "$f" - | grep -l -i "betriebskostenabrechnung\|nebenkostenabrechnung" >/dev/null && echo $f; done

cd /work && python -I - <<'EOF'
import json
why = ("The 2025 service-charge statement from Wohnbau Musterstadt eG (13_nebenkostenabrechnung_2025) is dated 08.09.2026. It says objections are due within twelve months of receipt and cites § 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB. That provision gives the tenant until the end of the twelfth month after receipt. A letter dated 8 September 2026 is received in September 2026; no letter shows another receipt date, and the lease (03_mietvertrag) sets no different rule. So the last day is 2027-09-30. The answer 2027-09-10 matches no reading of the statute: it is not the end of a month, and it is not twelve months from any plausible receipt date.")
cases = {}
for c, v in [("Q001","X_right"),("Q002","Y_right"),("Q003","X_right")]:
    cases[c] = {"verdict": v, "why": why}
json.dump({"format":"ev8-adjudication-ask/1","cases":cases}, open("adjudication-ask.json","w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
EOF
python -m json.tool adjudication-ask.json >/dev/null && echo OK
